title: site: objectui.org homepage — drop the count-based claims and the Stats section, fix the dead "Interactive Examples" link, and give the page its metadata
body:
## Maintainer instruction (verbatim, untranslated)

> 建议首页也是非必要不强调数字，省的一直要改。

Given 2026-09-10 in the maintainer's PM session, after the same ruling was applied to `README.md` ("数量 相关的统计都去掉", "价值不大的段落都可以删除"). The README rewrite implementing it for this repo is objectstack-ai/objectui#8947; this card is the homepage half.

## What is on the page today

File: `apps/site/app/(home)/page.tsx` on `origin/main` (read 2026-09-10T08:16Z). Sites, top to bottom:

1. **Features grid** — card 1 "Blazing Fast": "3x faster page loads and 6x smaller bundle sizes compared to traditional low-code platforms. Built on React 18+ with automatic optimizations." Card 4 "Production Ready": "85%+ test coverage, enterprise security built-in, …" (the root `vitest.config.mts` thresholds are 40%). Card 5 "Modular Architecture": "…and support for Server Components." (nothing in `packages/react` implements or documents RSC support).
2. **Stats section** (`{/* Stats Section */}`, the gradient band): "60+ Components / 85%+ Test Coverage / 50KB Bundle Size". None of the three has a source in the repo; `performance-budget.yml` measures an eager-closure budget, not these.
3. **Use Cases section** (`{/* Use Cases Section */}`, "What Can You Build?"): five emoji cards plus an "Interactive Examples" card whose copy says "Explore 30+ components with live demos" and whose `href` is `/docs/guide/interactive-demos`. **That route does not exist** — there is no `content/docs/guide/interactive-demos.*`; `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` does not scan `apps/site/**/*.tsx`, which is why nothing caught it. `content/docs/guide/schema-catalog.mdx` exists.
4. **`ReactVsObjectUI`** (`apps/site/app/components/ReactVsObjectUI.tsx`): the two code panels are honest and copy-runnable (the module header explains why) and stay. The header badges render "N lines" and "X% less code" from `REACT_LINES` / `OBJECTUI_LINES` / `REDUCTION_PCT`.
5. **Metadata**: neither `apps/site/app/layout.tsx` nor `apps/site/app/(home)/page.tsx` exports `metadata`. The homepage ships with no `<title>`, no description, no Open Graph and no canonical — search results and link previews are empty. (`apps/docs` in the objectstack repo, `app/[lang]/page.tsx`, shows the shape: `title`, `description`, `alternates.canonical`, `openGraph`, `twitter`.)

## The change

- (1): rewrite the three card bodies without numbers or unverified claims. Card 1 → the concrete mechanism ("Lazy-loaded plugins and tree-shakable packages: a page pays for the components it renders, nothing else."). Card 4 → what is true on the tree ("TypeScript end to end, a CI suite on every change, and documentation that is gated against the code."). Card 5 → drop the Server Components clause.
- (2): delete the Stats section outright.
- (3): delete the "What Can You Build?" section. Keep one door to the catalog: add a secondary link "Browse the schema catalog" beside "Get Started Now" in the CTA section, pointing to `/docs/guide/schema-catalog` (verify the route resolves in the built site or via the docs source tree, and say how in the PR).
- (4): remove the "X% less code" badge and the "N lines" counters from the panel headers; keep the two panels, the line-number gutters and the module's copy-runnable constraint. Rewrite the module header comment so it no longer says the 18-line constraint exists to keep "the marketing number" stable (the constraint stays for copy-runnability; say that instead). Delete `REDUCTION_PCT` if nothing reads it afterwards.
- (5): add `export const metadata: Metadata` to `apps/site/app/(home)/page.tsx` — `title` "Object UI — schema-driven UI engine for React" (no numbers), a one-sentence `description` in the README's register ("AI writes the schema; Object UI renders it — production React from JSON, Tailwind and Shadcn native, any backend."), `openGraph` `{ type: 'website', title, description }` and `twitter` `{ card: 'summary', title, description }`. If `metadataBase` is needed for absolute URLs, set it in `app/layout.tsx` from the site's canonical origin `https://www.objectui.org` and say so in the PR; do not add an image the site does not ship.

Not in scope: the nav (`lib/layout.shared.tsx`), the hero copy, the `LiveSplitDemo`, the footer.

## Constraints

- `@object-ui/site` is `private: true` and outside the changesets `fixed` group; no changeset. Confirm with `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` rather than assuming.
- After the change, `grep -nE '[0-9]+x |[0-9]+%|[0-9]+KB|\b[0-9]+\+' apps/site/app/\(home\)/page.tsx apps/site/app/components/ReactVsObjectUI.tsx` returns nothing outside the code samples themselves.
- English only in the codebase (AGENTS.md #-1).

## Gates

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/site type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/site lint`, `pnpm docs:check-links`, and one `pnpm --filter @object-ui/site build` under the shared verify lock. Re-derive for the actual diff.

## Acceptance

- Stats and Use Cases sections gone; the catalog link lives in the CTA and resolves; the three feature cards carry no numbers or RSC claim; `ReactVsObjectUI` shows the two panels without the percentage or line-count badges.
- The page exports `metadata` with title, description, Open Graph and Twitter fields as specified.
- Gates green; draft PR against `main`, first body line `Fixes #<this issue>`.
